CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid plugins by tabilzad. This repository publishes **Docker Batch Update**, which adds a Batch Update tab to the Docker page for updating several selected containers in one go. Support: the forum thread https://forums.unraid.net/topic/200997-plugin-docker-batch-update-update-only-the-containers-you-pick-in-one-go/ (bug reports also welcome at https://github.com/tabilzad/unraid-docker-batch-update/issues)
